title: entrance-envelope (envelope_version 1)
description: A serialized entrance-envelope. Fields marked "x-visibility": "internal" are resume state whose shape may change without a version bump; read the public ones.

envelope_version.description: The envelope format version (bumped when an envelope written now could not be read by the code that wrote it).

source.description: The content source: {atlasId}, the authored graph the shuffle runs over.

seed.description: The shuffle seed; draw k takes drawSeed(seed, k).

maxAttempts.description: The draws a run may take (refusals and rejections together).

sweep.description: The reach's inventory: 'placed' (default, vanilla items) or 'events' (GER's all-state).

gameName.description: The compiled world's game name (default: the substrate producer's own) — an entrance-randomized world is its own game.

completed.description: Index into ENTRANCE_STEPS of the last step run; -1 = none.

attempts.description: Every draw: {attempt, verdict, why?} (accepted / shuffle-refused / rejected-unbeatable / rejected-check).

classify.description: The substrate classifier's answer: doorways, target_group_lookup, pinned (each with its rule), outOfScope.

vanilla.description: The vanilla compile the shuffle binds its reach over.

shuffle.description: The current draw: {attempt, placements: [{exit, target}] by doorway id}.

compile.description: The accepted layout: rulesJson, its entrance_randomization block, moved exits, sphere count, attempts summary.
